author: Nerdstalgic
description:
American Psycho is widely considered one of the most iconic psychological thrillers ever made. Starring Christian Bale, the film helped cement Patrick Bateman as one of cinemas most unforgettable characters and turned the story into a cult classic that fans still analyze today.

But what many people don’t remember is that American Psycho actually got a sequel.  A really, really bad sequel that attempted to continue the legacy of the original film… but instead became one of the strangest and most confusing sequels Hollywood has ever produced.

#americanpsycho #patrickbateman #christianbale #nerdstalgic
title: When A Perfect Movie Makes A Terrible Sequel
